{{Quote|Great events happened here on Yavin 4… you can get a real sense of history.|[[Hoggon]]|<ref name="Redemption1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Yavin 4''' was one of three habitable [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. It was mainly covered in [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] and [[Forest/Legends|rainforest]], and despite being remote and unheard of, it would play an important role in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] events, including the seduction of Jedi Knight [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] to the dark side and the destruction of Sith Lord [[Freedon Nadd]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the site of the eventual final death of the maddened Jedi [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in the waning days of the [[Galactic War]], a ferocious [[Duel on Yavin 4|duel]] between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and serving as the base of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and as a battlefield in other battles of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. An attack was launched on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] from this [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. It also became the base for a Jedi Academy after the war ended.

==Geography==
===Landforms===
[[File:JKAlevelshot_yavin1b.png|thumb|left|Yavin 4 ecosystem]]
Yavin 4 was the largest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], which itself was located in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] and was part of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] about 40,500 [[Light-year/Legends|light years]] away from the [[Galactic Center|galactic core]].<ref name="CL" /> The moon was around 10,200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometres]] in diameter and was composed of a [[Magma/Legends|molten]] metallic core with a thick, immobile low-relief silicate crust, which made Yavin 4 dense enough to have a standard-type surface [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] similar to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="CL" />

The surface was made up of four continents which accounted for sixty-seven percent of the moon's surface. These continents were mostly covered in large sprawling tropical jungles with tall canopies though there were also a few [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ridges like the [[Yunteh Mountains]], dominated by [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] such as the [[Nicolo Peak|Nicolo]] and [[Borundi Peak]]s.

Yavin 4 also had six interconnected [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] which covered the remaining thirty-three percent of the moon. There was also a large landlocked sea on the moon. As a relatively young world, the tiny jungle moon experienced a considerable amount of geothermal activity. Large rivers flowed dramatically from volcanic heights and then followed a more meandering pace through the jungles.

When [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]] on [[Setor/Legends|Setor]] discovered the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] decades before the current era, the colonists dubbed these continents the names of [[Starloft/Legends|Starloft]], [[Swivven]], [[Koos]] and [[Wetyin/Legends|Wetyin]], though the scouts eventually left the moon.

===Species===
{{IBI|File:Woolamander.png|A native woolamander}}
Yavin 4's large, sprawling tropical jungles teemed with an abundance of life. [[Whisper bird/Legends|Whisper birds]] soared above the thick jungle canopy. Troops of arboreal [[Woolamander/Legends|Woolamanders]] fed on fruits in the thick jungle canopy. The trees were also home to another rodent [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Stintaril/Legends|Stintarils]].

Large and shaggy herbivores known as [[Runyip/Legends|runyips]] rooted through the underbrush beneath the trees, while [[Howler (Yavin 4)|Howler]] predators stunned their prey with loud cries. The moon's rivers also teemed with life including [[aquatic gundark]]s, [[Mucous salamander/Legends|mucous salamanders]], [[Crystal snake/Legends|crystal snakes]], crustaceans known as [[Angler/Legends|anglers]], [[crawlfish]], serpentine [[thyrsl]] and [[Armored eel/Legends|armored eels]]. Swarms of vicious [[Piranha beetle/Legends|piranha beetles]] scoured the air in terrifying swarms hunting for prey.

Yavin 4 experienced two extreme seasons; a wet season which caused violent storms, and a corresponding dry season.<ref name="Jedi Prince" />

==History==
===Old Republic era===
====Sith stronghold====
{{Quote|That Yavin was both a beautiful and a terrible god to the Massassi. It lifted their eyes to the heavens, but made their hearts small and fearful.|[[Streen]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] after reading the [[Books of Massassi]].|<ref name="BtS" />}}
[[File:Tfotse12.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Naga Sadow supervising the construction of the Temple of Fire]]
In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] [[Battle at the Denarii Nova|fled]] to Yavin 4 on his flagship, the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']], along with an army of [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors following the [[Second battle of Korriban|defeat]] of his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith invasion fleet|forces]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="FOTSE5" /> He then conducted [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemic]] experiments on his Massassi warriors, causing them to mutate from red-skinned humanoids into fearsome, savage, hunchbacked predators. Despite these abuses, his Massassi [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] built huge [[Massassi Temple|temples]] to honor<ref name="DLotS4" /> their Dark Lord.<ref name="Golden4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>

Sadow also encased himself in a Sith sarcophagus, where he remained in a coma-like trance for centuries, waiting for someone to call upon his power and continue the history of the Sith. He remained in suspended animation until [[4400 BBY]], when a fallen Jedi named [[Freedon Nadd]] arrived at Yavin 4. By then, the descendants of the Massassi had devolved into a primitive hunter-warrior society. At first, the Massassi attacked Nadd, though his use of the Force amazed them. Impressed by Nadd's Force powers, the bestial Massassi showed him where the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] rested, waiting for another with dark-side potential to find him. Nadd then awoke Naga Sadow, who taught him in the ways of the Sith, until—as was the Sith's nature—Nadd killed him<ref name="NEC" /> and declared himself Dark Lord.<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

Centuries later, in [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the fallen Jedi [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] went to Yavin 4 at the advice of the dark-side spirit of Freedon Nadd. There he discovered the Massassi, who tried to sacrifice him to a monstrous [[Sith wyrm|beast]] of alchemical origins beneath the [[Temple of Fire]]. However, using his dark powers, he managed to save himself. The dark-side manifestation of Freedon Nadd appeared, delighted with Kun's actions and claiming him as his ally—though Exar Kun would hear none of this and instead used his newly found Sith powers to destroy Nadd.<ref name="DLotS4" />

As the new Dark Lord of the Sith, he enslaved the Massassi and took over Yavin 4. He used his Massassi slaves to construct new Sith temples and palaces, based on Sith architecture and designed to focus dark powers. His slaves also discovered the ''Corsair'' beneath the ruins of the Temple of Fire.<ref name="DLotS5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 5]]</ref> He also created vicious [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]], including the [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydras]], [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]],<ref name="NEC" /> and the [[Kalgrath|Night Beast]].<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> The Sith Lord also imprisoned the souls of the children of the Massassi in a malevolent dark-side device known as the [[Golden Globe]].<ref name="Lyric's World">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Lyric's World]]''</ref>

Later, Kun allied himself with the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], another group of dark-siders based in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] under the leadership of [[Aleema Keto]] and another fallen Jedi, [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]].<ref name="DLotS6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref> In [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Kun went to the Jedi world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]<ref name="TSW1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref> and recruited twenty Jedi to his cause, thus starting the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]]. Kun, along with his Krath and Mandalorian allies, waged war on the Republic and the Jedi.<ref name="TSW2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref> The Jedi eventually prevailed and gathered their forces for an [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|assault on Yavin 4]]. However, as the orbiting Jedi fleet launched a wall of light-side power which bombarded the jungle moon, Kun gathered his Massassi followers into the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] and drained their life energies in order to free his spirit from his body and invest it into the surrounding structures,<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> where he would remain for millennia.<ref name="DA" />

====Jedi Cleansing====
The Jedi attack obliterated much of the jungles and scorched the temple complex to the extent that nothing could survive. After the attack, the Jedi established an [[Lost City of the Jedi|underground city]] on the moon and used it to modify the climate of the moon into a jungle state and to help restore the planet's ecosystem and ensure that Kun is never awakened.<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> During the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], the moon was [[Cleansing of Yavin 4|cleansed]] of [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]] by the Jedi.<ref name="shadows" />

The Jedi eventually left Yavin, erasing information about the moon hoping to end its evil legacy;<ref name="TEA" /> though in later years at least one individual still knew its location, as the "Jedi prince" [[Ken]] was hidden there by a brown-robed Jedi Master. The city was eventually rediscovered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who trapped the imposter [[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]], [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Supreme Prophet]] of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], there.<ref name="PODS">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref>

====Galactic War====
[[File:Yavin4.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Yavin IV during Revanite crisis in the midst of the Galactic War]] During the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurrected Sith Empire]], the former Jedi Master and former Sith Lord [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] began plotting against both sides. His followers, called the [[Order of Revan]] or the Revanites, took over Yavin 4. Revan planned to resurrect the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], who remained in an incorporeal state after his defeat by the [[Hero of Tython]], so that he could kill the Emperor once and for all. [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Theron Shan]] and Sith Lord [[Lana Beniko]] brokered a truce between the Republic and the Empire so that they could work together to defeat Revan. Republic and Imperial forces, led by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Marr]] respectively, [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|invaded]] the moon. Revan was ultimately defeated, but the Sith Emperor regained some of his strength regardless and left the moon.<ref name="SoR" />

===Rise of the Empire era===
[[File:Anakin_Yavin4.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] follows [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighter]] to Yavin 4, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
The system was rediscovered by hyperspace scouts from the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and became the site of a brief rush on [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]] inside the gas giant.<ref name="TEA" />

About four hundred years before the Battle of Yavin, the [[Kushiban]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ikrit]] came to the moon and discovered the [[Golden Globe]] within the [[Palace of the Woolamander]]. Unable to break the curse and free the countless trapped Massassi children, he waited until someone came along who could.

The [[Wolhanian expedition]] of archaeologists found a [[Darth Sidious' Sith Chalice/Legends|Sith Chalice]]. A [[Great Hyperspace War Bas-Relief|bas-relief depicting Jedi and Sith battling in the Great Hyperspace War]] was also found in an archaeological excavation of a Massassi site. Both of these items ended up in the art collection of Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="CL" />

During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] tracked [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to Yavin 4 following her attack on Republic starfighters at the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]. It was here that she destroyed Anakin's customized [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi Starfighter]], the ''[[Azure Angel]]'', as well as killing the clone troopers that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sent to follow him. Anakin and Asajj had their first duel through the thick jungles and the Massassi ruins until Anakin bested her and knocked her off one of the temples. She was presumed dead and he took off in her [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighter]].

===Imperial era===
====Rebel base====
{{Quote|It's where all the idealists hang out, I hear.|Han Solo to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SWradio">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:WhatsTheSpearFor-ANH.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] starfighters leaving Yavin 4 to engage the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]]]
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] pilot [[Dr'uun Unnh/Legends|Dr'uun Unnh]] scouted the moon as a potential base for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="Insider 92">{{InsiderCite|92|Refresher Reading}}</ref> The moon was home to the Rebel Alliance's main military base, Massassi Station, built from the Great Temple of the Massassi, prior to and during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The Rebels established this base in following the abandonment of their previous base on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sought to use its new [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]], to destroy the small jungle moon and crush the Rebellion. Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], the Empire sent a legion of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to confirm Rebel presence on the moon. They discovered the rebels, and established a monitoring outpost at the [[Massassi Arena]]. Following the skirmish, a small force of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were sent to destroy the Death Star, but most were killed in the attack. With the timely assistance of his friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was able to fire two [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into a small thermal exhaust port in a small trench near the northern pole, thus destroying the station and saving Yavin 4. A great ceremony was held following the Death Star's destruction, where [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] bestowed medals of honor upon Luke Skywalker and Han Solo, along with his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-pilot, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

This battle became known as the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], and its date is used galaxywide for marking events. Events before the Battle of Yavin are marked by BBY, and events that occur after are marked by ABY.<ref name="NEC" /> A few days after the battle, Solo and Chewbacca stole ancient Sith treasures from the temples, and sold them, to finance replacements for the devastating Rebel losses against the Death Star.

====Imperial onslaught====
The Rebels remained on the moon for 6 months afterwards, until finally escaping the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade. Yavin 4 requested the assistance of the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] in order to protect their evacuating ships in space. General [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] remained behind, blowing up a temple to damage the Imperial forces. Under the secret observation of [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] wiped out the remaining ground troops and captured the injured Dodonna, whom Vader interrogated until Dodonna revealed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] presence on [[Reytha]]. Dodonna was then imprisoned aboard the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', although most Rebels, and even Mara Jade, mistakenly believed him dead. The Empire then occupied the moon.

[[File:Dark_Time.png|thumb|right|200px|The ancient Great Temple was occupied by forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around 0 ABY.]]
The Empire maintained a military base, a [[Labor Outpost|labor outpost]], and a [[Mining Outpost (Yavin 4)|mining outpost]] on the planet. Because of Yavin 4 by that point being under Imperial jurisdiction, the Empire also granted access towards tourists via [[Intergalactic Passport]]s.<ref name="IGP">[[Intergalactic Passport (real-life artifact)|Intergalactic Passport]]</ref>

===New Republic era===
Following the defeat of the Galactic Empire in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] presumably took back the jungle moon from the Empire. The small village of [[Vornez]] was established and the [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network]] was headquartered on Yavin 4 though it would later be replaced by [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]].

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], after receiving a vision from [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Luke Skywalker searched for and discovered the [[Lost City of the Jedi]]. Here he found [[Ken]], a young boy and the heir to the former [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] who'd been hidden there by the Jedi and taken care of by droids. When the self-proclaimed emperor [[Trioculus]] heard about the discovery of the city and the young boy, he led an assault on the planet with squadrons of [[Treaded Neutron Torch]]es and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] however he was defeated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

====Jedi teaching center====
[[File:JediVersusJuggernaught-NEC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A group of Jedi ambush an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut|Juggernaut]].]]
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Luke Skywalker chose Yavin 4 as the site for the [[Jedi Praxeum]] and the headquarters of his [[New Jedi Order]] after receiving permission from the New Republic. During his travels, he had discovered a number of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] and finally felt ready to begin to train new Jedi.<ref name="Jedi Search" /> This first class consisted of twelve pupils with Luke as their teacher. Some of those twelve were [[Kam Solusar|Kam]] and [[Tionne Solusar]], [[Kirana Ti]],<ref name="DA" /> [[Madurrin]],<ref name="Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> [[Kyle Katarn]],<ref name="jk2">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref> [[Dorsk 81]],<ref name="DA" /> [[Brakiss]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]],<ref name="IJ" /> [[Streen]], and [[Gantoris]]. Other Jedi to join soon after were [[Kyp Durron]], [[Cilghal]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]],<ref name="DA" /> and [[Dal Konur]].<ref name="Rebel Jedi">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031023rebel|text=Rebel Jedi|int=Rebel Jedi}}</ref>

It was not long before it became apparent that not all was well at the Academy. The spirit of Exar Kun, Sith Lord, haunted a [[Temple of Exar Kun|temple]] on the moon and began to influence Luke's students towards the dark side. Kun attacked Luke, forcing him into a coma, and Kyp Durron, one of the most promising students, fled the Academy in the [[Sun Crusher]],<ref name="DA" /> wreaking havoc on the galaxy and destroying the Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Eventually Luke was awoken and the Sith spirit was defeated by a joint Jedi offensive including the then infant [[Solo twins]].<ref name="CotF" />

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] and then [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] attacked the Jedi Praxeum with a fleet of 17 [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]]<nowiki/>s and the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Knight Hammer]]''. Legions of Stormtroopers and ground assault vehicles were also unleashed on the Jedi who fought them back by using the Force to drive the Imperials to the edges of the Yavin system though [[Dorsk 81]] was killed in the process.<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

[[File:Escape_pod_yavin4.jpg|thumb|right|Kyle Katarn and Jan Ors' [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] in the swamps of Yavin 4]]
Later that year, the [[Empire Reborn]] under [[Desann]] and Admiral [[Galak Fyyar]] attacked the Jedi Praxeum though they too would be defeated by the efforts of the Jedi and their New Republic allies. Because of his heroic actions, Kyle Katarn chose to rejoin the New Jedi Order.<ref name="jk2" />

====Unwitting discoveries====
[[File:ThirdBattleOfYavin-YJKJUS.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The battle for Yavin 4 rages.]]
In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], [[Anakin Solo]] (the youngest of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]] children) and [[Tahiri Veila]] discovered the Golden Globe and the Kushiban Jedi Master Ikrit during an exploration of the crumbling [[Palace of the Woolamander]]. With the help of Ikrit and ancient Massassi engravings found at the Palace and on nearby [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]], the pair broke the curse of the Golden Globe, thus freeing the trapped Massassi children.

In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], during an exploration of the surrounding jungles, the Solo twins [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], along with their friends [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] and [[Lowbacca]] discovered the wreckage of a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] from the Battle of Yavin. Unfortunately, the [[TIE pilot|pilot]] of the vehicle [[Qorl]] reappeared and took the Solo twins hostage, forcing them to repair the damaged ship before escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to rejoin the Empire.

Later that year, the Jedi Praxeum was attacked by the dark side [[Shadow Academy]] and the Imperial insurgency group [[Second Imperium]]. However, they were defeated by the combined efforts of the Jedi and their New Republic allies.

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
====Praxeum's destruction====
For the first year the of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the moon was protected from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] via use of the Force to create an illusory projection, a technique borrowed from the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]]. However, the Jedi Praxeum was destroyed by the Yuuzhan Vong in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. The [[Peace Brigade]]/Yuuzhan Vong [[Invasion of Yavin 4|victory]] was partially due to the fact that the New Republic was unwilling to provide aid for the Jedi. By then, most Jedi had been mobilized for military action and only the youngest Jedi adepts and trainees remained at the Jedi Praxeum. The destruction of the "heretic Jeedai" provided a large morale boost to the Yuuzhan Vong.

The Jedi Anakin Solo and the smuggler kingpin [[Talon Karrde]], along with his personal fleet, managed to evacuate the vast majority of the remaining Jedi trainees, though the [[Kushiban]] Jedi Master [[Ikrit]] was killed by the Peace Brigade troops and Tahiri Veila was captured.

====Yuuzhan Vong occupation====
[[File:Yavin4ShaperCompound_njosb.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The shaper compound on Yavin 4]]
With Yavin 4 in their hands, the Yuuzhan Vong initiated a [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongforming]] program on the moon by using [[damutek]]s to flatten the ancient Massassi temples and then establishing a colony. Meanwhile, the [[Master Shaper]] [[Mezhan Kwaad]] and her apprentice [[Nen Yim]] began performing experiments on Tahiri, in an attempt to brainwash her by replacing her personality with that of Riina Kwaad, an identity formed out of memories copied from Nen Yim's own childhood.<ref name="EOV1" />

Rather than have his friend Tahiri suffer in the hands of the enemy, Anakin went on a mission to rescue her. With the help of Qorl who had been eking out a life in the jungle ever since the defeat of the Second Imperium and the [[Shamed Ones|Shamed]] Yuuzhan Vong [[Vua Rapuung]], Anakin managed to infiltrate the Yuuzhan Vong compound disguised as a slave.<ref name="EOV1" />

While in the enemy base, Anakin learned that [[Vua Rapuung]] had once been a skilled [[Warrior caste|Warrior]]. He once had an affair with Mezhan Kwaad. When Rapuung decided to break off the affair, Kwaad, fearful he would reveal their affair, infected him with a virus that caused his body to reject implants he received after his escalation, rendering him a Shamed One. Rapuung, however, knew that Kwaad was responsible. Faced with a common enemy, Rapuung agreed to help Anakin rescue Tahiri on the condition that he would help him confront Kwaad.<ref name="EOV1" />

Together, they made it to the damutek where Kwaad had been reshaping Tahiri into believing she was Riina Kwaad. They then fought their way into a shuttle that carried Kwaad, Nen Yim and Tahiri. In front of hundreds of Yuuzhan Vong ranging from [[Shaper caste|Shapers]], Warriors, [[Worker caste|Workers]] to Shamed Ones, Rapuung confronted his former lover, who had just been discovered to be practicing heresy, and demanded she answer whether the Gods were responsible for his shaming, or if she was. Kwaad admitted her role, then mortally wounded Rapuung with a weapon concealed in her Shaper Hand.<ref name="EOV1" />

Dying, he gave Anakin Solo and Tahiri Veila enough time to escape. Anakin and Tahiri fled, along with Qorl and the others, on a repaired freighter. This incident started a legend among the Shamed Ones that said he was redeemed in his death, thus beginning the [[Jeedai heresy]]. Members of this sect saw the Jedi as saviors rather than enemies, and would be cultivated on worlds such as [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]]<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> and conquered Coruscant, helping to topple the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]].

===Later history===
Following the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|liberation]] of Coruscant from the Yuuzhan Vong in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Grand Master Luke Skywalker dismissed the notion of rebuilding the Praxeum, however, stating that the Praxeum had served its purpose, and that the Jedi would find a new home [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|elsewhere]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Yavin4.png|thumb|200px|Yavin IV from Star Wars Galaxies]]
The real-world location of Yavin 4 is the ruins of an ancient Mayan city at [[Tikal]], [[Wikipedia:Guatemala|Guatemala]].

Most of the shots of approaches to Yavin 4 from space are just repeats or copies of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] approach in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], the only change being a ship replacement.

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Yavin 4 in the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]].

The online game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' features two hidden Jedi Enclaves on the planet, one light and one dark. They served as meeting places for Jedi of the game, and were guarded by two CL 500 [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]]. As of Chapter 7, the enclaves are no longer in usage, and the Sentinels have been removed, but the ruins of the enclaves could still be visited.
